court: REPLACE: the court's name exactly as VIDHI lists it (see the Courts list in Admin > Deadline data)
year: REPLACE: a year such as 2026, as a number
source_url: REPLACE: the official https link where the court publishes this calendar
source_checked_on: REPLACE: YYYY-MM-DD, the day you compared this file with that link
weekend_days: REPLACE: a list of weekly days off, 0 = Monday ... 6 = Sunday, or [] if none

holidays.name: REPLACE: the holiday's name as the court writes it
